sections.brief: Fixes inside the constitutional ceiling (CU 5-4 on spending, 8-1 on disclosure): NYC 8:1 matching (Malbin & Parrott), Seattle vouchers (59.12% renewal, Hoffman critique), presidential fund collapse (CRS); disclosure (DISCLOSE 49-49 in 2022, reintroduced 4 Mar 2026; AFP v. Bonta); revolving door (HLOGA, AER 24%); NRSC v. FEC 30 June 2026 6-3; amendment (54-42, 2025 reintroduction) and Montana I-194. Figures: flow (worked matching example); compare (money fixes)

NPV compact (222 EV, legal objections and replies); independent commissions (AIRC 2015 5-4, Nelson 2023, FairVote critique, Prop 50 suspension); top-two (McGhee & Shor, MA Q3, 2024 defeats); term limits (Thornton, NCSL study); AVR (Oregon, Seljan, CA DMV errors); votes at 16 (Takoma Park, SF/Oakland/Prop 18); The test. Figures: flow (compact trigger); compare (structure fixes)
